experience.cue: A carry or approach goal needs the robot (holding an object) to stand within about 1 m of a target, but the target is boxed in by furniture. The gaps between pieces are narrower than 2× the planner's body radius, so the end-stance search on the standard inflated nav map returns 0 free or 0 routed cells within reach. The pieces lining the gap are low (their tops are well below the hands and the held object), so in reality only the legs could touch them.
experience.lesson: In the end-stance planner (near.plan_stance → plan_end), keep the standard search on the 0.35 m-radius map with NEAR_MARGIN_M 0.15 as the first pass and leave its results alone. Only when it yields no stance, re-run the same candidate search and route on a skill-local map built like pick.nav_map (floor boxes included) at body radius 0.28 m, with the distance margin cut to 0.05 m. Accept a narrow route only if, at each sample point lying inside the 0.35 m inflation, every collision hull or surface slab within 0.35 m tops out at ≤0.46 m; occupied cells no hull explains, such as walls, count as infinitely high. Do not go below 0.28 m or drop the height guard: a 0.88 m hull caught an arm at 0.26 m. Check it by logging narrow=true, the radius and top_passed per round, and confirm the 'no end stance' failures fall and falls stay at 0.
experience.evidence: Row iter1 narrow fallback: remote diag 0/13→12/13 with 0 broken; gate 'no end stance: 0 free cells' 11→2; sealed remote 0/20→15/20; 0 falls at the gate. Accepted candidate gate b=11 c=0, p=0.00049 (13→24/60). Iter 0, without the fallback, left the remote at 0/13 with 11/13 dying at 'no end stance' on the 0.35 m map. Margin row: NEAR_MARGIN 0.05 probed on 8 canister carries gave 8→8, no breaks. An offline sweep found no stance within 1.4 m at radius 0.35/0.32, 1.04 m at 0.30 and 0.99 m at 0.28. The prototype's 6/6 narrow rounds ended −0.18 to +0.014 m from plan.
experience.confidence: medium. The effect is large and the sim is deterministic, and the flipped starts are exactly those whose failure reason was the missing stance. But it rests on one target corridor in one scene (one sofa with a 0.20 m table and a 0.40 m armchair). The 0.46 m guard was never seen to refuse a route here. The gated candidate also carried SIDE_AHEAD and the pull-back follow fix (those touch the canister and one remote start). Two carry drops at the gate are unattributed.
